_note: Single source for the August Finals surfaces (/finals, /finals/live, /winners). status: 'pending' (finalists named, battles not yet run) | 'live' (battles running) | 'settled' (results final). /finals/live renders the roster as soon as finalists[] is non-empty; /winners stays on its placeholders until settled:true with ranks filled. Each finalist: rank (final placement 1..N, or null pre-settlement), name, handle (e.g. @builder), repo (owner/repo), demo (URL), track (artist|builder|creator), prize, collectible ('champion'|'finisher'). Finalists are PEOPLE, not projects - two per track, picked by Zaal after the board closed on 2026-08-16. There was no vote. Battles run on live WaveWarZ community battles, not WaveWarZ-Base.
_battles_note: The three head-to-head battles, rendered by /august and by the next-battle card on /live. TO PUBLISH A BATTLE: fill date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (display string, timezone included - the /live countdown parses the label, so use EDT or EST), watch (stream URL) and window (one sentence describing how the battle actually runs), then flip status to 'scheduled'. No HTML edit needed. window is the single source of truth for the timing - do not restate it in page copy, or it drifts. Artist and creator run inside a one-hour Space; builder is a 24 hour battle with endDate/endTime. status: 'scheduling' | 'scheduled' | 'live' | 'done'.

battles.window: Space opens 5:00 PM EDT. The battle runs 5:15 to 5:45, and the winner is called before the Space ends.

A 24 hour battle. Opens with a Space at noon Saturday to talk through what both builders made this season, then the clock starts. They build in the open and post progress to the timeline, and the battle can be traded the whole way through. The last hour is the live finale, where both share what they built in the 24 hours.
